response:
To change the bank account your salary goes to, follow these steps: [hr-bank-details-howto::s02p0]

1. Open the HR system from the employee portal.
2. Go to *My Profile* > *Bank Details* and select *Request Change*.
3. Enter the new account details exactly as they appear on your bank document.
4. Upload the cancelled cheque or bank statement.
5. Submit the request. The Payroll team verifies it and you receive a notification when it is approved. [hr-bank-details-howto::s03p0] If the change is approved before the payroll cut-off, your next salary goes to the new account. Otherwise it takes effect from the following salary run. Keep your old account open until you see a payment arrive in the new one.
